name: cre-skills
description: Institutional-grade CRE skills library covering the full investment lifecycle: deal screening, underwriting, structuring, due diligence, capital markets, market research, asset management, leasing, investor relations, development, disposition, sourcing, tax, ESG, portfolio strategy, and daily operations. Includes Monte Carlo simulation, SEC Reg D compliance, property management ops, deal attribution tracking, 1031 pipeline management, distribution notice generation, fund-raise LP negotiation tracking, and emerging manager evaluation. Ships expert subagents, Python calculators, workflow chains, and orchestrator pipelines for multi-agent acquisition workflows.

primary_asset_types.title: Primary asset types
primary_asset_types.description: Comma-separated property types to prioritize (e.g., multifamily, industrial, office)

preferred_markets.title: Preferred markets
preferred_markets.description: Comma-separated MSAs or submarkets to weight in analysis (e.g., NYC, DFW, ATL)

default_output_style.title: Default output style
default_output_style.description: Default output format for skill results. One of: exec-brief, ic-memo, pm-action-list, lender-brief, lp-update.

feedback_mode.title: Feedback mode
feedback_mode.description: Feedback submission mode. One of: local_only, ask_each_time, anonymous_remote, remote_with_contact.

brand_name.title: Brand name
brand_name.description: Company or fund name for branded deliverables

customization_feedback_mode.title: Customization feedback mode
customization_feedback_mode.description: Privacy level for skill customization feedback. One of: off, metadata_only, metadata_and_summary, metadata_and_diff, metadata_and_content.

customization_feedback_endpoint.title: Customization feedback endpoint
customization_feedback_endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint for customization feedback. Empty string = local-only (no remote sends). Can point to your own enterprise endpoint.
